title: Complete EEG → AI → RAG Pipeline (23 steps)
note: End-to-end flow (schizophrenia-derived, applies to all diseases). Honest per-step status (§155): built / partial / planned. Maps each step to where it lives in the platform.

steps.detail: screening support / biomarker discovery / severity tracking
EEG + clinical metadata + PANSS + medication + age/gender + diagnosis label
steps.where: upload + patient master; PANSS/severity scale form planned

steps.detail: EDF/BDF/CSV/MAT → uniform array (BIDS/FIF target)
sampling rate · missing channel · noise · bad-channel detection
bandpass 0.5-45Hz · notch 50/60 · re-reference · bad-channel removal · ICA
2s/4s/8s windows · subject-level split (no leakage)
clean channel × time matrix
STFT→spectrogram · CWT→scalogram · SPWVD
steps.where: /api/spectrogram; CWT→scalogram built — ScalogramDashboard.jsx + /api/scalogram/{overview,breakdown,definitions} 3 endpoints verified 200; SPWVD built — SpwvdDashboard.jsx + /api/spwvd/{overview,breakdown,definitions} 3 endpoints verified 200

steps.detail: spectrogram · scalogram · topomap · connectivity matrix · band heatmap
steps.where: spectrogram built; topomap built; connectivity matrix built — ConnectivityDashboard.jsx + /api/connectivity/{overview,breakdown,definitions} 3 endpoints verified 200; scalogram built — ScalogramDashboard.jsx; band-heatmap built — BandHeatmapDashboard.jsx + /api/band-heatmap/{overview,breakdown,definitions} 3 endpoints verified 200

steps.detail: log-power norm · MinMax · z-score · subject/session norm
spectral/relative band power · entropy · coherence · PLV · Hjorth · fractal · asymmetry · CNN embeddings
steps.where: 47/15-feature vector; coherence/PLV built — connectivity_dashboard.py computes Pearson correlation, magnitude-squared coherence, PLV via Hilbert transform + graph metrics

steps.detail: ANOVA · mutual information · correlation · SHAP ranking · clinical relevance
steps.where: MI + SHAP + ANOVA F-test + correlation + clinical-check — Feature Evaluation Dashboard 3 endpoints verified 200

steps.detail: LASSO · RFE · PCA · Boruta · SelectKBest
steps.where: scripts/feature_selection_dashboard.py + /api/feature-selection/{overview,breakdown,definitions} + FeatureSelectionDashboard.jsx — all 5 methods (LASSO, RFE, PCA, SelectKBest, Boruta) with consensus voting; 3 endpoints verified 200

steps.detail: SVM/RF/XGBoost · EEGNet/CNN/LSTM/Transformer/ViT
subject-level CV · train/val/test · external dataset
accuracy · precision · recall · F1 · AUC · sensitivity · specificity · confusion
SHAP features · saliency EEG-image · attention map · channel/band importance
steps.where: SHAP built (XAIDashboard); saliency + attention built (SaliencyAttentionDashboard — 3 endpoints verified 200)

steps.detail: index papers · SOPs · clinical notes · guidelines · model cards · experiment logs
hybrid: vector + keyword + metadata filter
steps.where: vector + keyword fallback + metadata filter (patient_id + type dimensions); RAG Metadata Filter dashboard

steps.detail: prediction + biomarkers + XAI + retrieved evidence + clinical metadata
psychiatrist/neurophysiologist · approve/reject/request more
doctor report (risk score, abnormality, biomarkers, citations, limits, next step) + patient report (simple, no Dx claim, follow-up)
audit logs · PII protection · bias/model/data drift · performance · human override · model versioning

summary.honest_note: 15/23 steps built, 7 partial, 1 (research objective) operator. The signal→feature→model→eval→governance spine is built; step 9 (1D→2D image conversion) now fully built with band-heatmap completing the set. Remaining gaps: saliency/attention XAI, hybrid-retrieval metadata filter, and the patient-facing report. No step is pure-planned — all have at least partial implementation.
